title: SB1596 (89th Legislature Regular Session): Relating to the prohibition of short-barrel firearms.
operative_text:
Sec. 1 (amending Penal Code 46.05(a)): (a)  A person commits an offense if the person intentionally or knowingly possesses, manufactures, transports, repairs, or sells:
Sec. 1 (amending Penal Code 46.05(a)(1)): (1)  any of the following items, unless the item is registered in the National Firearms Registration and Transfer Record maintained by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives or otherwise not subject to that registration requirement or unless the item is classified as a curio or relic by the United States Department of Justice:
Sec. 1 (amending Penal Code 46.05(a)(1)(A)-(C)): (A)  an explosive weapon; {+or+} (B)  a machine gun; [[-or-] [[-(C)  a short-barrel firearm;-]]
Sec. 1 (amending Penal Code 46.05(d)(1)): (1)  was incidental to dealing with a [[-short-barrel -] [-firearm or-]] tire deflation device solely as an antique or curio;
Sec. 2: SECTION 2.  Section 46.01(10), Penal Code, is repealed.
